review.notes: Independent package review (Claude Opus 5.5, session claude-A3UO6l). Read README, Suggested.lean and metadata.toml in full against the accepted 32-node plan. All four public sources were re-read at every locator: BSKK arXiv:2007.14567v3 pp.4-5 and 54-63, Babai's 2018 notes pp.3-10 (p.7 page image confirms Lemma 8.5 is about the complement), Schomburg arXiv:2209.12049v1 pp.1-5, Bary-Soroker-Kozma arXiv:1710.05165v2 pp.9-10. All targets, hypotheses, 38 API items and 34 tests are present. Every definition has at least 3 discriminating Checks. Adversarial pass over all 32 targets (degenerate cases, Bochert endpoints, e^gamma/8 < 1/4, strictness of the block-orbit inequalities); it found one false strict inequality in 5.3 (equality at theta=0, kappa=1), now corrected. Other corrections: the Lean certificate now places the witness in the root-action image; removed blanket classical DecidableEq/Decidable local instances and an unused import; the 0.4 statement now gives the plan's full conclusion; 5.1 now says s' points in each block; added an occurrence-sensitive E1 Check with its example; fixed the Babai locators in 4.2 and 4.4; recorded that only the upper Mertens bound is used; named Real.log_two_gt_d9 and the current-library Polynomial.rootSet_divByMonic_X_sub_C; title, wording and consumer status. Duplication sweep of current TauCetiRoadmap main and current Tau Ceti a91d3aaf: no target exists there and none was removed. lean-check at Mathlib 082e2d3 / Tau Ceti f790474: exit 0, 34 warnings, all 'declaration uses sorry' (33 before the edits), no errors. check_sorry_data passes; intake check-files reports 0 problems. Maintainer note: this roadmap is outside the 94-roadmap order and cites AnalyticNumberTheory AN.2 (upper Mertens bound with constant e^gamma, whose constant identification is still open in that plan) and AN.5 (divisor bound). It must follow that tier-14 package upstream, or those two statements must move down here.
